title: Kinetic vs Potential Energy
hook: Potential is stored. Kinetic is motion.
narration: Potential is stored. Kinetic is motion.
A held ball has potential. A falling ball spends it as kinetic.
Energy changes form. The total in a closed system stays put.
That bookkeeping is conservation of energy.
